get_api_key: get the MiniMax API key from environment variable or parameter fallback
get_api_base: get the MiniMax API base URL defaulting to the international endpoint
get_complete_url: build the complete MiniMax chat completions URL from base URL components
remove_cache_control_flag_from_messages_: return messages and tools unchanged since MiniMax supports cache_control
get_supported_openai_params: get the list of supported OpenAI-compatible parameters for a MiniMax model
